questions.rationale: The paper identifies a contradiction where NbTaTiV exhibits edge dislocation dominance unlike conventional BCC metals, but this is observed primarily at room temperature. Determining if this boundary holds at service temperatures is critical for selecting this alloy for high-temperature applications.
questions.decision_use: Decides whether to proceed with NbTaTiV for high-temperature structural components or requires alloying adjustments to maintain the edge-dislocation mechanism.
answer_requirements: In-situ TEM straining experiments at temperatures >500°C to identify the Burgers vector and slip plane of mobile dislocations.
